idea.problem: Model a safe sub-range copy operation (like SoPath::copy(start, count)) over an indexed sequence, correctly handling an empty or out-of-range start, an excessive requested count, and the arithmetic needed to validate start+count without signed-integer overflow.
users: contributors reviewing sub-range/slice APIs across the codebase
capabilities: avoid signed-integer overflow when validating a start offset combined with a count against a total length
clamp an excessive requested count to the remaining length instead of treating it as an error
reject an out-of-range start position unconditionally, not only in debug builds
express a sub-range using two absolute bounds instead of an offset-plus-count pair
constraints: C++11 as the minimum supported language standard
must not allocate more than the resulting sub-range needs
non_goals: changing the container's own element storage
supporting negative indices as counting from the end
